name: Fear
when: Risky action · about to delete or overwrite

variants.name: Tremble
variants.desc: Shrinks a little and shivers, with a bead of sweat on its head.

variants.name: Hide
variants.desc: Ducks down flat, peeks left and right, then ducks again.

variants.name: Jump scare
variants.desc: Leaps in fright with a double !!, then lands still trembling.

variants.name: Nervous sweat
variants.desc: Eyes dart side to side, sweat flies off and it gulps.

variants.name: Back away
variants.desc: Leans back and slides away from something off to its right.
